summary: The visible suite now passes (3 passed). All three failures came from one bug in `solution/core.py`: binary operations got their operands in the wrong order. The code popped `a, b = pop(), pop()`, so `a` was the top of the stack (the right-hand operand) and `b` was the value under it (the left-hand one). Every non-commutative operation was computed backwards. `LT` gave `2 < 1`, `DIV`/`MOD` checked the wrong value for zero, and `SUB` in the countdown loop gave `1 - x` instead of `x - 1`, so the loop never reached zero and hit the step limit. I changed the line to `b, a = pop(), pop()` so `a` is the left operand and `b` the right. I also fixed a related bug in `SWAP`, which no visible test covers: it popped both values and pushed them back in their original order, so it did nothing. It now swaps the top two values (`[1, 2]` → `[2, 1]`). `solution/core.py` is the only file I changed, and the public API is the same.
